cand.title: PDAC 2027 Convention
cand.excerpt: PDAC publishes the Toronto dates, MTCC venue, multi-day exhibit/program schedule and international investor, finance, mining and government audience.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Nicole Sampson — Senior Director, Convention (416-362-1969 ext. 226; convention@pdac.ca is the published convention channel, not a verified personal email); Stefanie Wolf — Manager, Convention Operations (416-362-1969 ext. 293); Christy Clough — Coordinator, Convention and named Presentation & Reception Rooms contact (cclough@pdac.ca; 416-362-1969 ext. 208). Relevant respectively to senior convention account development, operational coordination, and ancillary-room inquiries. None is verified as hotel-contract signatory or accommodation budget owner. Sources: https://pdac.ca/about-pdac/staff; https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/attending-2027/registration-2027/pdac-terms-and-conditions-for-convention-attendees-2027; https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/programming-2027/presentation-and-reception-rooms-2027.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: March 7–10, 2027, Toronto, Ontario, Canada, within the requested horizon. These are activity dates, not publication dates. The FAQ separately schedules short courses on March 5–6 and registration beginning March 5; do not relabel those as the main convention dates. Source: https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/attending-2027/frequently-asked-questions-2027. PDAC also announces 2028 programming applications for spring 2027, but no official 2028 event dates or city were verified: https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/get-involved-2027/programming-opportunities-2027.
findings.hotelProductFit: Important correction to the seed: Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown is already an official 2027 hotel partner. PDAC publishes a $449 promotional rate, Feb. 2, 2027 cutoff, booking reference “The World's Premier Mineral 2027 PDAC”, frontdesk@radissonblutoronto.com, (437) 886-9667, and an eight-minute walk to MTCC. It states “Limited availability remains on select nights only.” Source: https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/attending-2027/accommodation-and-travel-2027/hotels-2027. Inference using the supplied 157-room/meeting-space profile: realistic roles are existing delegate bookings, small delegation or speaker/VIP groups and ancillary meetings; not exclusive convention housing or plenary hosting. The supplied 15–109-room targeting range is a sales-fit constraint, not published event demand. Verify actual dates/inventory and restaurant/lounge/catering capability before offering any reception or food-and-beverage package.
findings.venueCommitments: Metro Toronto Convention Centre, 222 Bremner Boulevard, Toronto, Ontario; Fairmont Royal York Hotel, 100 Front Street West, Toronto, Ontario. Both are in Toronto proper, downtown/MTCC territory, not a suburban or resort destination. Fairmont is an edition-specific convention venue as well as a published hotel-rate partner; no evidence of exclusive housing. Sources: https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/attending-2027/key-dates-venue-info-2027; https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/attending-2027/accommodation-and-travel-2027/hotels-2027.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified annual Toronto recurrence, not evidence of rotating destinations: 2024 March 3–6; 2025 March 2–5; 2026 March 1–4; 2027 March 7–10. Recent editions use MTCC with Fairmont Royal York events. Do not infer that any historical block remains available or that 2028 dates are confirmed. Sources: https://pdac.ca/about-pdac/news-publications/press-releases/pdac-2024-the-worlds-premier-mineral-exploration-and-mining-convention; https://pdac.ca/about-pdac/news-publications/press-releases/pdac-2025-draws-27-353-participants-to-toronto; https://pdac.ca/about-pdac/news-publications/press-releases/pdac-2026-reflects-growing-global-momentum-for-mineral-exploration-and-development; https://pdac.ca/convention-2027.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Edition-specific PDAC 2027 Hotel Partners page publishes direct hotel booking routes and promotional rates/blocks. Exact instruction: “Book directly with your hotel(s) of choice using the links we provide above.” Exact responsibility statement: “PDAC does not manage hotel reservations and does NOT use 3rd party housing bureaus.” All 17 listed hotels: Crowne Plaza Toronto Airport; Chelsea Hotel, Toronto; Hotel X Toronto; Novotel Toronto Centre; Union Hotel; Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown; Doubletree by Hilton, Toronto Downtown; Hyatt Regency Toronto; Hilton Toronto; Courtyard by Marriott, Downtown Toronto; Marriott Downtown at CF Toronto Eaton Centre; Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel; The Westin Harbour Castle; One King West Hotel & Residences; InterContinental Toronto Centre; Delta Hotels Toronto; Fairmont Royal York Hotel. The Airport property is not a downtown venue. This is more than a generic preferred list: the page publishes 2027 rates, reservation references and cutoff dates. It does not disclose contracted room quantities, organizer pickup obligations or an open RFP. Source: https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/attending-2027/accommodation-and-travel-2027/hotels-2027.
findings.organizationStructure: PDAC is the membership association and event organizer, not the venue or a hotel housing bureau. Its official About page describes a 24-member board, 15 committees and permanent staff. MTCC and Fairmont Royal York are venues; the 17 hotels handle guest reservations directly. No third-party PCO/DMC hotel-procurement mandate was established. Sources: https://pdac.ca/about-pdac; https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/attending-2027/key-dates-venue-info-2027; https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/attending-2027/accommodation-and-travel-2027/hotels-2027.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Edition-specific competing rate/block commitments are published for all other 16 partners. Selected material competitors: Hotel X $425 Deluxe/$450 Corner/$725 Suite, code G-PDA1, Feb. 12 cutoff; Hyatt Regency $489/$599 and limited select-night availability, reference PDAC 2027 Convention; Sheraton Centre $556 Standard/$620 Premium/$795 Club, Jan. 4 cutoff; Westin Harbour Castle $556 Standard/$662 Premium, Jan. 4 cutoff; Fairmont Royal York $839 Fairmont/$899 Luxury, Jan. 25 cutoff, plus convention-venue role. Hilton Toronto ($515/$565/$645), InterContinental Toronto Centre ($589/$689), Delta Hotels Toronto ($589/$801), and Union Hotel ($440) are marked PDAC promo-rate SOLD OUT. These are published rate/block statuses, not proof the entire hotels are sold out. InterContinental is attached to MTCC North and Delta to MTCC South. All quoted rates are subject to MAT/HST. No edition-specific commitment for Le Méridien Toronto Pinnacle or Toronto Marriott City Centre was found on this official list; Marriott Downtown at CF Toronto Eaton Centre is a different listed property. No block sizes, pickup or proven displaced-room volume are published. Source: https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/attending-2027/accommodation-and-travel-2027/hotels-2027.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First reconcile Radisson’s existing 2027 PDAC agreement/listing with its revenue and reservations teams: date-by-date remaining allocation, minimum stays, cutoff, pickup and ability to add rooms. Then contact Nicole Sampson and Stefanie Wolf to validate the hotel-partner selection/renewal process and ask who manages delegation and speaker referrals; do not assume either signs contracts. Ask Christy Clough whether wait-listed presentation/reception applicants can be introduced to offsite options, subject to PDAC policy and hotel catering verification. Offer only verified remaining rooms or a small bespoke group proposal, not an invented open block. After the 2027 event, review actual pickup and seek future-cycle renewal timing; do not quote unannounced 2028 dates. Sources establishing these routes: https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/attending-2027/accommodation-and-travel-2027/hotels-2027; https://pdac.ca/about-pdac/staff; https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/programming-2027/presentation-and-reception-rooms-2027; https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/get-involved-2027/programming-opportunities-2027.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Commercially accessible through an existing partner channel, not greenfield housing acquisition: Radisson already has an advertised PDAC rate but only select-night limited availability. Published promo-rate sellouts at four partners provide sourced compression signals, not a guarantee of overflow referrals or additional Radisson capacity. PDAC also reports its MTCC Presentation & Reception Rooms are wait-listed because offers have been extended for all space; this supports testing ancillary demand, not claiming any specific offsite booking. Sources: https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/attending-2027/accommodation-and-travel-2027/hotels-2027; https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/programming-2027/presentation-and-reception-rooms-2027.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: prioritize retaining/improving Radisson’s existing hotel-partner allocation and winning delegation-level share in later cycles, rather than replacing MTCC/Fairmont or selling an all-attendee block. Annual Toronto history supports repeat account development. PDAC explicitly says 2028 programming applications will open in spring 2027, establishing future planning activity but not hotel sourcing dates, a 2028 venue award or announced 2028 event dates. Sources: https://pdac.ca/convention-2027; https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/get-involved-2027/programming-opportunities-2027; https://pdac.ca/convention-2027/attending-2027/accommodation-and-travel-2027/hotels-2027.
